# Reyes Tires Pro

> Tire and wheel shop in Escondido, California. Sells quality used and new tires and wheels. Brands: Michelin, BFGoodrich, Pirelli, Falken, Milestar (tires); Forte (wheels).

- Address: 260 N Juniper St, Escondido, CA 92025
- Phone: (442) 999-5014 (call for a quote)
- WhatsApp: (619) 564-1742
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 8:00 am to 6:00 pm; Sunday 8:00 am to 3:00 pm
- Website: https://reyestirespro.com/
- Sizes: all tire sizes except large farm and agricultural tires (per the shop owner; call to check a specific size)
- Guides: https://reyestirespro.com/tire-size-guide/ (how to read a tire size); https://reyestirespro.com/tire-basics/ (used vs new, tread depth, tire age)

Only the facts above are confirmed. For prices, stock, or services not listed here, call the shop.
